q: Let staff teleports move a frozen player, who then stays frozen?
why: Staff can bring them somewhere quiet.

why: Repeat offenders are not forgotten.

why: Fast for common cases, complete for rare ones.

q: Give the Kick button a fixed reason, with /kick for custom reasons?
why: One click for the common case.

why: They always know why chat does not work.

why: An undone warning should not leave its penalty behind.

q: Give every warn button the same weight in the warning count?
why: Simple ladders staff can predict.

q: Add the last 5 public chat lines from other players as context in punishment evidence?

q: Let every player use /ack to confirm a warning, with one join reminder per warning?
why: Players cannot claim they never saw it.

why: The report was handled.

q: Let an applied anti-cheat suggestion count toward that reason's punishment steps?
why: Same ladder for every source.

why: Helpers are limited (P8); mods do most.

why: Clear cases need fast action, and the reason is logged.

q: Keep shadow mutes out, so every mute shows the player a message?
why: Honest and clear for players.

q: Add a short 2-line explanation of each rule on the website and in /rules?
why: Fewer 'I didn't know' appeals.

q: Add a 30-day trade block, covering /ah and trading, to scamming and RMT punishments?
why: Protects the economy from repeat scams.

q: Keep archived chat, command and item logs for 12 months, then delete them?
why: Matches IP history (529) and privacy rules.

q: Let players request a copy of their data through a ticket, exported by an admin?
why: Required by privacy law.

q: Keep private messages out of staff log exports, except in a player's own data request?
why: Privacy for others, while players get their own data as the law requires.

q: Add a staff note button to pin a comment to a log line, later?

why: They know what to do and where to go.

why: No player stays stuck if the first staff member leaves.

q: Keep closed reports for 1 year and show the last 100?
why: Enough history for repeat offenders.

q: Tell reporters only 'handled' or 'no evidence found', never the punishment?
why: Protects privacy and avoids arguments.

q: Let staff inspect other staff, logged and with admins told?
why: Checks rogue staff without hiding it.

q: Show the number of open reports on the staff scoreboard and tab?
why: Reports get handled faster.
